description: This file implements the service layer related to inventory movements, stock updates, and alert generation for an inventory management system. It defines business logic functions for registering movements, checking stock thresholds, and managing related alerts.

classes.name: MovementResult
classes.description: A simple data class summarizing the result of a stock movement, including the created movement, the inventory item affected, and any generated alert.

methods.name: bool is_below_minimum_stock(item: InventoryItem)
methods.description: Checks if an inventory item's quantity has fallen below its configured minimum threshold, indicating whether an alert should be generated.

methods.name: MovementResult register_movement( *, item: InventoryItem, from_location: Optional[Location], to_location: Optional[Location], movement_type: str, quantity: int, performed_by, performed_at, notes: str = "", )
methods.description: Handles the creation of a stock movement record, updates inventory quantities and locations based on movement type, and manages automatic alert generation or closure based on stock levels.

ctags.name: register_movement
ctags.signature: ( *, item: InventoryItem, from_location: Optional[Location], to_location: Optional[Location], movement_type: str, quantity: int, performed_by, performed_at, notes: str = "", )
